.intel_syntax noprefix
.include "stubbi/math/0.4.0/x86_64-linux/src/min.s"

.section .text
.global _start
_start:
    mov edi, 12
    mov esi, 37
    call asm_u64_min
    cmp rax, 12
    jne .Lfailure
    mov eax, 1
    mov edi, 1
    lea rsi, [rip + message]
    mov edx, message_end - message
    syscall
    mov eax, 60
    xor edi, edi
    syscall
.Lfailure:
    mov eax, 60
    mov edi, 1
    syscall

.section .rodata
message: .ascii "min(12, 37) = 12\n"
message_end:
.section .note.GNU-stack,"",@progbits

dependency_source.text:
.intel_syntax noprefix
.section .text
.global asm_u64_min
.type asm_u64_min, @function

/* Return the smaller unsigned 64-bit input.
 * ABI: Linux x86-64, System V.
 * Input: rdi = a, rsi = b. Every 64-bit value is permitted.
 * Output: rax = min(a, b), with unsigned comparison.
 * Clobbers: rax and flags. Other registers are unchanged.
 * Memory: no data access. RET reads the caller's valid return address.
 * Stack: no local storage. The caller must supply a valid call frame.
 */
asm_u64_min:
    mov rax, rdi
    cmp rdi, rsi
    cmova rax, rsi
    ret
.size asm_u64_min, .-asm_u64_min

.section .note.GNU-stack,"",@progbits
